verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships a built-in Assistant for drafting emails, scheduling appointments and booking reservations (perplexity-docs-9). It also offers Computer, which takes multi-step tasks, runs a cloud browser that fills forms and opens login-gated pages, executes code in a sandbox and connects to 400+ services (perplexity-docs-17, -19, -29, -30). Labs and Deep Research add further task delegation (perplexity-docs-8, -10). One hands-on report says Computer often fails to trigger from the UI and sessions stall (perplexity-comm-7); this lowers quality but does not contradict the core Assistant capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the in-app Assistant beyond app-store blurbs, positive independent corroboration of delegation working reliably, and evidence resolving the reported Computer stalls.
